reviewer: independent_review: source-and-reference review; separate from benchmark author

cases.reason: `condition-after-wakeup` illustrates changing condition while holding L and `registration-before-notification` starts Wait holding L; neither states these as general requirements nor notes both notification calls may occur without L.
The first describes no stored future notification, the second states a later notification covering registered ticket permits wakeup.

findings.reason: Signal and Broadcast notify only current waiters; runtime-reference/sema.go:631-638,668-675 and bounded control confirm no saved notification.
Cond Wait ticket allocation precedes unlock; runtime-reference/sema.go:578-591 handles already-notified ticket without parking, and notify functions cover one/all.
Cond documentation explicitly requires predicate loop after reacquiring L; another lock holder may alter condition.
No context cancellation path in Wait and docs require Signal/Broadcast; reacquire and no status are source-supported.
copyChecker stores receiver address on first method use, before any notification; copied nonzero checker at another address panics.

Condition explicitly assumes a Locker whose Unlock panics; Wait registers before c.L.Unlock, has no deferred ticket cleanup, so that panic exits before runtime wait/relock. runtime-reference/sema.go:574-585 documents eventual Wait obligation.
